title: Melting Balloon in Haunted Hall
description: A surreal scene inside a long, decaying hallway with dusty wooden floors marked by black footprints leading toward three steps. A large, melting purple and yellow hot air balloon with dripping wax-like texture floats in front of a massive cracked mirror that reflects the eerie interior.
